Welcome to Your First Bra Journey 💕

Getting your first bra is an important milestone! It's completely normal to feel unsure or have questions. This guide is here to help you feel confident and comfortable. Remember: every body is different, and there's no "right" age or size.

💗 Remember: Your size is just a number. The most important thing is how your bra feels. If it's comfortable and you feel good wearing it, that's what matters most!

When Do I Need a First Bra?

There's no set age for getting your first bra. Some girls start wearing one as early as 8 or 9, others not until their teens. Here are some signs it might be time:

  • You notice your breasts are developing (buds forming).
  • Your nipples show through your clothes.
  • You feel uncomfortable without support when running or playing sports.
  • You see other girls your age wearing bras and feel ready.

What Type of First Bra Should I Choose?

🩱 Bralettes

Soft, wire-free, and comfortable. Great for beginners. No cups or underwire – just lightweight support. Perfect for small to medium busts.

✅ Best for: First-time wearers, small busts, everyday comfort.

👙 Sports Bras

Compression style, great for activity. Keeps everything in place during gym, sports, or running. Available in low, medium, and high impact.

✅ Best for: Active girls, sports, gym class.

👗 T-Shirt Bras

Lightly lined with smooth cups. Invisible under t-shirts and tops. A step up from bralettes for more coverage and shape.

✅ Best for: When you want more coverage and shape.

🌸 Wire-Free Bras

Like a regular bra but without underwire. Soft cups with adjustable straps. Good for growing bodies.

✅ Best for: Growing busts, comfort, everyday wear.

How to Measure for Your First Bra

Don't worry – measuring for your first bra is easy! Here's a simple guide to help you (and maybe a parent or friend) get the right numbers.

  1. Underbust (Band): Wrap a soft tape measure around your ribcage right under your bust. Keep it snug but not tight. Breathe out normally and write down the number.
  2. Bust (Cup): Wrap the tape measure around the fullest part of your chest (across your nipples). Keep the tape level and don't pull it tight. Write down this number.
  3. Enter both numbers: Input them into the calculator above and click "Find My First Bra Size". We'll do the rest!

Frequently Asked Questions

What if I'm between sizes?

That's completely normal! Try both sizes and see which feels more comfortable. Many girls are between sizes – especially when they're first starting.

Do I need an underwire bra?

Probably not for your first bra! Most first bras are wire-free for comfort. Underwire can be uncomfortable for developing breasts. Start with soft, wire-free styles.

What if I don't want to wear a bra?

That's completely okay! Some girls choose not to wear bras, and that's your choice. You should do whatever makes you feel comfortable and confident in your body.

Does IMRango store my measurements?

No. Everything runs locally in your browser. We do not collect, store, or share any of your personal data or measurements. Your privacy is important to us!
